$comment: The rive-mcp commit this repo builds rigs with and measures them against. Rigging is generated, not authored (art-pipeline.md section 3), and the generator lives in another repository — so 'which version' has until now been tribal knowledge carried in commit messages. It is pinned here because the CLI plays two different roles and both of them want a fixed version. As a BUILDER its output is committed: a rig regenerated by a different version is a different binary, and the manticore mesh bug (art-pipeline.md section 6.4) is what a silently-moving builder looks like. As a RENDERER it is the measuring instrument for art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and a measuring instrument that drifts turns a green gate into a coin toss — the rest floor is 99.80% and two manticore tiers sit at 99.97%, so there is 0.17 points of room for a renderer that rasterises differently. CI reads `ref` from this file, so bumping the renderer is a visible commit that runs every gate against the new one rather than a change nobody can see. Bump it deliberately: rebuild the rigs, run art:verify:rig:rest and art:verify:rig:motion, and commit the pin with whatever the rebuild changed.
$refComment: Merge of rive-mcp #6 — varuint triangle indices (660bcc0) on top of the two-domain mesh crop (#5). The first version under which all 24 rigs pass art:verify:rig:rest.
